description:
Use this when a research agent needs a quick headline for one company or the whole AI buildout: capex, year-over-year growth and whether it is speeding up. Answers 'How much is Microsoft spending, and is it accelerating?' Pass optional symbol (e.g. MSFT) or omit it for the universe total. Returns BitTuitive's recommended ai_intuitive value plus a Data BitScore (coverage and filing freshness). 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Pick get_ai_data kind=stats to compare layers or build a table, kind=pro for the full history in one call, kind=signals for whether the buildout is accelerating or rolling over and whether capex is outgrowing cash flow. Informational only, not investment advice. Figures are as reported in SEC filings, company-wide, not an official AI-spend line; not affiliated with or endorsed by the SEC. Returns JSON in the `data` field. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

symbol.description: Optional US ticker (e.g. MSFT). Omit for the universe total. Unknown tickers are rejected before any invoice.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
